title: Cherrypicking
author: Opentrons
materials: Create your CSV file according to our instructions.

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Download the provided CSV template, edit it to specify coordinates (in millimetres from the bottom‑left corner of deck slot 1) for up to two source wells and up to ten destination locations, and adjust any pre‑defined values to match your labware and workflow.

steps.title: Upload CSV to protocol
steps.instruction: In the protocol interface, upload your edited CSV file at the parameter “Transfer .csv File”.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Select all desired settings in the “Setup” section to customize the run (e.g., pipette type, tip rack, volumes, etc.).

steps.title: Download OT‑2 script
steps.instruction: Click the blue “Download” button located above the deckmap to download the customized OT‑2 protocol file.

steps.title: Load protocol into Opentrons App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol into the Opentrons App, then follow the app’s instructions to set up the deck, calibrate your labware, and start the run.
